harness.notes: js/audio.js is self-contained (no imports). Music is driven by M.tick(dt, night), which the game calls every frame; play therefore starts a 10 ms setInterval. Battle/boss only sound while combatT > 0, so play keeps calling M.combat() every 0.5 s (it sets combatT = 2.5). Mute/volume are read from localStorage 'wb.mute'/'wb.vol' at load.

notes: Same sound engine as SageCanyon (identical music code), so these six tracks will sound like SageCanyon's; the gallery may want to keep only one copy. tick() also starts a quiet looping wind noise (ambience) that will be faintly audible under every track. Field/shrine are random phrases (no fixed loop). Battle 132 bpm, 32 half-beat steps = 7.27 s; boss 150 bpm = 6.4 s; village 16 x 0.38 s = 6.08 s.
